prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 多级表头 · 半年度指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "指标" spans 1 col × 2 row; "2023 年" spans 2 col × 1 row; "2024 年" spans 2 col × 1 row; "备注" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "2023 年 › 上半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "2023 年 › 下半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "2024 年 › 上半年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 46px
  col 5: header "2024 年 › 下半年" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 46px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 349px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较营业收入、毛利率和研发投入在2023年与2024年各半年的变化，并阅读相关备注。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较四个半年度数值；备注提供解释，可在比较数值后阅读。","groups":["第1列是行标题，应与同一行的四个数值保持清晰对应。","第2至5列都是半年度数值，按年份两两分组，适合采用一致的宽度以便横向比较。","第6列是说明性文字，内容较长，可比数值列更灵活地换行。"],"keep_intact":["半年度表头和各期数值，尤其是百分比及其百分号。","指标名称应尽量完整，避免难以辨认的逐字拆分。"],"may_wrap":["备注可按中文语义自然换行，并利用同行其他单元格换行形成的行高。","空间紧张时，指标名称可在自然语义边界换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [75, 60, 60, 60, 60, 44] · table 360×996px · row heights [36, 60, 525, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 5/8 · tallest cell 22 lines · mid-word splits 6
Design r0B: widths [100, 67, 67, 67, 67, 120] · table 489×299px · row heights [36, 36, 106, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 129px
Design r0C: widths [144, 67, 67, 67, 67, 200] · table 613×229px · row heights [36, 36, 83, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 253px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"整张表落在首屏，年份分组和各指标仍可辨认。","problems":"表头和百分比被拆开，备注几乎逐字竖排，使数据行极高，难以横向比较；指标名称也被拆得不自然。","cause":"四个数值列各60px，扣除内边距和边框后不足以容纳完整的半年度表头和百分比；备注列44px仅剩23px文字空间，指标列75px也过窄。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"四期表头和数值完整且等宽，便于按行比较；指标名称换成两行仍可辨认，备注换行后行高也较合理。","problems":"需要横向滚动才能阅读备注；首屏末端贴近最后一列数值，阅读时可能需要轻微滚动。较长备注仍明显决定了第一条数据行的高度。","cause":"四个67px数值列保证了内容完整，但与100px指标列及120px备注列合计后超出视口129px。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"指标名称、表头和数值都完整，200px备注列减少了换行，整表更紧凑。","problems":"首屏无法同时看到四期数值，跨年份比较需要滚动；备注距离行标题更远，横向滚动成本也明显增加。","cause":"144px指标列容纳最长名称的同时占用了首屏空间；200px备注列进一步使表格超出视口253px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"比较优先","widths":[90,67,67,67,67,130],"change":"保留完整且等宽的四期数据，将指标列缩至90px，使四期数值基本进入首屏；备注列增至130px，以减少长备注换行。总宽488px。"},{"name":"备注平衡","widths":[90,67,67,67,67,160],"change":"沿用比较优先的前五列，将备注列加宽至160px，探索较低行高与额外横向滚动之间的平衡。总宽518px。"},{"name":"紧凑滚动","widths":[75,67,67,67,67,110],"change":"将指标列收窄至75px，让四期数值更稳妥地落在首屏；备注保留110px，减少滚动距离，代价是指标名称和备注有更多换行。总宽453px。"}]}
